summary: Custom records and edited-catalog records cannot preserve temperatures or per-field provenance.
claim: Custom records and edited-catalog records cannot preserve temperatures or per-field provenance.

evidence.source: CustomRecord entity in Databases.kt has columns only for id,brand,material,product,color_name,color_hex,diameter_mm,mass_g,updated_at; no nozzle_min_c, nozzle_max_c, bed_min_c, bed_max_c, and no per-field source/provenance. CustomRecord.asCatalogEntry() in MainViewModel.kt maps all temperatures to null and sets sourceRevision='user' for every field. CustomDialog in MainActivity.kt exposes only brand/material/product/color/hex/diameter/mass, no temperature inputs. MainViewModel.decodedSeed() drops min_temp, max_temp, bed_min_temp, bed_max_temp from decoded tag values.

suggested_remediation: Add temperature columns and per-field provenance columns to CustomRecord (or a normalized editing table). Extend custom UI and decodedSeed() to include temperature fields. Store original source per field for edited catalog records and preserve it across catalog replacement.
suggested_validation: Create a custom record with nozzle/bed temperatures, restart the app, verify temperatures and per-field provenance are retained. Edit a catalog entry, replace the catalog, verify edited metadata and original source per field remain intact.
